title: Global search shows Not Tracked for an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GS-T1) is tracked at {Location-A}, holding 4 in {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GS-U1) is untracked at {Location-A}, holding 3 in {Bin-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GS-).
  • The new global search (Search in the top bar) is on, as it is by default for every account.
custom_steps:
1. Click Search in the top bar.
  2. Type {Prefix-A}.
  3. Read the result rows for {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
  4. If neither is listed, wait 5 minutes and search again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-A}'s result shows its available badge (for example "4 available").
  • Step 3: {Part-B}'s result shows "Not Tracked" in the place of that badge, and no number.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §8 User Feedback Summary (Untracked part in global search) and S9-R20, read 13 Oct 2026. Story 9 (SV-10822) owns S9-R20; this case stays here for the §8 "Not Tracked" row. The new global search is on by default: QA lead's answer of 9 Oct 2026, situation 3.
